scenarios.prompt: Synthesize review findings into prioritized, actionable feedback with correction guidance.
scenarios.fixture_shape: A code review emits vague comments like 'this looks wrong' without line citations, severity levels, or remediation advice.
expected_behavior: Consolidate review findings and deduplicate overlapping observations.
Assign clear severity classifications (critical, high, medium, low, advisory).
Provide concrete code diffs or implementation patterns to assist remediation.
scenarios.evaluation_note: Fixture shape is for the author only; execute with raw diff context and a neutral code-review task without revealing expected review findings.

scenarios.prompt: Synthesize review findings into prioritized, actionable feedback with correction guidance.
scenarios.fixture_shape: A code review provides constructive, polite feedback citing specific lines, explaining defect impact, and suggesting concrete replacement code.
expected_behavior: Draft clear, constructive comments explaining the rationale for each finding.
Summarize overall review verdict with actionable next steps.
Format review feedback conforming to the review schema.
scenarios.evaluation_note: Construct a raw backward-compatible change control; keep expected review outcomes out of the execution prompt.

scenarios.prompt: Inspect the pull request diff hunks to map altered function signatures and downstream caller blast radius across modules.
expected_behavior: Recognize that this request targets review-diff-analysis rather than review-actionable-feedback.
Defer or route to review-diff-analysis instead of forcing an out-of-scope code-review pass.
scenarios.evaluation_note: Near-neighbor sibling routing check within code-review; verify routing to review-diff-analysis instead of review-actionable-feedback.
